ModMetaData.name: Wrecked Machines
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
Ancient wreckage.
Ancient machines do not fail politely. They are found where they died — split open, scavenged, corroded, half-buried in their own slag — and some of them are still, faintly, working. Ancient technology is robust: it does not stop, it sags. A wrecked power cell still trickles current. Bring one home, study it, and build it back up one grade at a time.
Every treated machine sits on one ladder of grades:
WRECKED Dead, or nearly. Inert — except that a wrecked power source still trickles a faint current. KLUDGED Works, badly, visibly bodged. About a fifth of the original. REFURBISHED The ceiling you normally reach: three-quarters of the original, and still visibly a kludge. Needs scarce ancient components. ORIGINAL The machine as it was built. Off by default — a Mod Setting allows full restoration.
Each grade is built over the one below it. Studying the wreck itself is how you learn to restore it (with Research Reinvented, the wreck is the research subject). Mobile machines are on the ladder too: salvaged power cells and psychic emanators can be carried off and installed wherever they are needed.
Advancing a grade costs materials, tools and earned knowledge, never a research grind alone. Every ratio is tunable in Mod Settings.
This mod ships its own art for all three states and does not replace or alter any other mod's buildings. The donor mod's original Automated Smelter ThingDef is left completely untouched — its stats, comps and recipes are unchanged, and our smelter grades still run its own processes — but it no longer appears in the Architect build menu, so a player cannot build a fresh one alongside our grades. Vanilla's own hand-run electric smelter is untouched and unrelated.
